code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

'''

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if fill not in row]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]
    nonfill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != fill)
    neutral = nonfill.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Plain outer lattice lines carry only the neutral color; retain marker-bearing lines.
    line_rows = [r for r in line_rows if any(grid[r][c] != neutral for c in line_cols)]
    line_cols = [c for c in line_cols if any(grid[r][c] != neutral for r in line_rows)]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(line_rows, line_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(line_cols, line_cols[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0]) == 4 and vals[0] != neutral else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

def make_grid(h,w,rr,cc,fill,neutral,nodes):

    for c in cc:

    for i,r in enumerate(rr):
